scope: Register six TU2-discovered dynamic XAM party/community procedures, make XexGetProcedureAddress resolve callable guest tokens without static IAT entries, and validate the runtime dispatch boundary.

build.testEvidence: Release CTest: 3 focused test executables pass; the final rebuild/rerun of xenon_session_tests passed 1/1 in 6.20 seconds.

changes: Added six real XAM export identities: ordinals 0xAFF, 0xB00, 0xB0B, 0xB10, 0x305, and 0x30B, each with explicitly limited offline behavior.

XexGetProcedureAddress now allocates stable runtime-owned guest thunk tokens for registered XAM procedures even when the title has no matching static import thunk; calls are routed through the normal ExportRegistry handler, never through a host pointer.

Added a session integration test that performs dynamic ordinal lookup twice, checks stable thunk identity and import recognition, and calls the returned thunk through XenonSession::call to verify the offline XamPartyGetUserList result.

probeEvidence.result: All six XexGetProcedureAddress requests returned stable guest tokens at 0x3FEF9000 through 0x3FEF9014. This proves lookup only; the title did not invoke these six callbacks in the observed trace.

Release host mounted the exact TU2 image and executed the startup initializer path. A bounded 90-second run stopped at 2,840 guest blocks; no dynamic XAM lookup, renderer, first frame, or gameplay was observed. The cooperative stop completed.

The headless Release session remained active for roughly six minutes and recorded guest-thread samples across threads 1–5 and 9. Latest persisted samples were thread 1 at 0x82C71598 (sample 901120), thread 2 at 0x8229B38C (679936), thread 3 at 0x8283E578 (663552), thread 4 at 0x8229B344 (663552), thread 5 at 0x8229B2C0 (778240), and thread 9 at 0x8229F744 (4096). No XexGetProcedureAddress request for the six party/UI exports appeared in the trace. The stop signal did not end guest execution within the runtime's five-second grace, so the host terminated the process. No renderer or first-frame claim is made; the config intentionally selected renderer=None/headless mode.

review.independentEvidenceReview: The integration test exercises the production session registry, XexGetProcedureAddress handler, import recognition, and XenonSession::call dispatch. Runtime logs prove exact-TU2 pointer resolution in runs 95/96. The title-level callback invocation and full startup/rendering path remain unproven.
review.gate: Card 07 remains PARTIAL; native execution, first frame, gameplay, SBS, browser-native execution, and release acceptance remain open.
review.nextAction: Map the current multi-thread startup samples and slow initializer path to exact guest functions, then instrument the first unobserved call/return boundary with low-overhead per-thread evidence before changing service semantics.
